history.position: THIS COURSE TEACHES NO REPAIR HISTORY. The lead's decisions on the engine (every deal term a required input, the value of the transaction stated with reg. 19(3)'s definition taught, the Penn State figures as a cited check only, the simple uplift added in engines #274 without moving any value) landed before any lesson was written; that is provenance.

regulatoryRule: Every Act, regulation, guide and teaching text is named with its edition or gazette date and the date read (2026-09-27), printed in digest section 2 and asserted against the vendored FINDINGS-farmout.md. Every quotation is in concepts.json with its citation and is verified against the public text by quote_check.py (the files hash to the pinned sha256 prefixes, which FINDINGS records). The PIA 2021 gazette, the Assignment of Interests Regulations 2024 (S.I. No. 67) and the HMRC Oil Taxation Manual (OGL v3.0) are public and quoted with citation. Penn State EME 801 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) is used for its printed NUMBERS only, as a cited check, and never quoted: the course is sold. Licensed model farm-out and operating agreements (AIPN, AAPL, CAPL) are never quoted or named as a source. No legal figure is invented: the fee rates, days and surcharge of reg. 19(2), (7) to (9) and the 50 percent of PIA s.95(14) are cited; every deal term is a required input with no default.

openReadings.valuation timing: the success-case value at the valuation date; well costs, bonus, reimbursement and fees at the valuation date, undiscounted. Never graded: every field bit-identical under reading_costs_discounted_one_year (farmout_capstone.mjs, discriminate.mjs).
openReadings.fee day count: days from the notification to the payment, the notification day not counted (reg. 19(7)). Never graded: bit-identical under reading_days_count_notification_day.
openReadings.ninetieth surcharge day: surcharged; the consent is deemed withdrawn from the ninety-first (reg. 19(9)). Never graded: bit-identical under reading_withdrawn_on_the_ninetieth_surcharge_day.
openReadings.simple uplift: a simple-interest uplift (HMRC OT18360) pays the accrued interest first, then the principal, with interest on the outstanding principal only (jointVenture.carryRecovery, engines #274). Never graded: no capstone states uplift type simple (asserted).
openReadings.value of the transaction: a required input with its source (reg. 19(3)); taught as a stated input and no reading.

scopeSeams.carries, back-ins and the joint operatin: OWNED BY the joa course; this course runs carryRecovery and backIn on the interests after a farm-in and refers there.
scopeSeams.decision trees, EMV and the value of inf: OWNED BY the decision course; this course applies the canonical rollback, evpi and evii to the two sides of a deal.
scopeSeams.portfolio choice and risk measures: OWNED BY the portfolio course; this course runs portfolioRiskMetrics on the two positions of a deal and grades none of it.
scopeSeams.ledger arithmetic, discounting and NPV: OWNED BY the cashflow course; this course imports the canonical npv and applyJV and refers there.
scopeSeams.the Nigerian fiscal system: OWNED BY the pia course; this course quotes PIA 2021 s.94, s.95, s.233(10), s.264(f) and s.302(12)(c) only.

namingCollisions.interest: always qualified: participating, working, carried or vested interest; 'simple interest' or an 'uplift' for money added to a carry.
namingCollisions.promote: the share of the gross cost paid less the interest held after the event, in points; the promote ratio is the share paid over the interest held.
namingCollisions.carry: the part of the farmor's cost share the farminee pays; a development carry is the later development cost, recovered from the farmor's production.
namingCollisions.consideration: what the farmor receives: carry, cash bonus and reimbursement; the value of the transaction is reg. 19(3)'s amount.
namingCollisions.break-even: always of a named term: the break-even promote or the break-even chance of success.
namingCollisions.farmor and farminee: the engine's names; the texts' farmee, farmer in and farmer out are quoted as printed.

plan.state: FOUNDATION: structure, digest, capstones, fields, precision, truth, panels, learning page, gates, writer briefs. Stops before lessons.

fieldsDiscrimination.ogbaku_ihe_well_payment: the earned share alone, the promote points alone, the share of the farmor's interest, the bonus counted in the payment
fieldsDiscrimination.ogbaku_ogb_well_payment: the farmor's post-deal share, its whole interest, the promote as its payment, the bonus taken off
fieldsDiscrimination.ogbaku_promote_ratio: the ratio over the farmor's retained interest (engine plant), the points as the ratio, the ratio inverted, the ratio over the farmor's interest
fieldsDiscrimination.ogbaku_carry: the whole payment as the carry, the carry on the farmor's share, the farmor's payment as the carry
fieldsDiscrimination.ogbaku_consideration: the bonus counted twice and the whole past costs reimbursed (engine plants), the carry left out, the whole payment counted
fieldsDiscrimination.ogbaku_equivalent_wi_pct: the outlay without the cash and the whole past costs (engine plants), the share paid as the equivalent, the outlay over the farmor's share
fieldsDiscrimination.umunze_well1_amg_payment: the gross cap ignored and the overrun rules swapped (engine plants), the excess at the share paid, the excess at the farmor's interest
fieldsDiscrimination.umunze_well2_umz_payment: the carry cap ignored (engine plant), the cap left out, the farmor's pre-deal share less the share paid, the event's own interest
fieldsDiscrimination.umunze_amg_emv: no dry-hole cost, the bonus twice, the whole past costs, the scaling applied twice, the gross cap ignored (engine plants)
fieldsDiscrimination.umunze_breakeven_share_pct: solved on the farmor's EMV, no dry-hole cost, the bonus twice, the whole past costs (engine plants)
fieldsDiscrimination.umunze_amg_breakeven_chance_pct: the wrong side of the line, no dry-hole cost, the bonus twice, the gross cap ignored (engine plants)
fieldsDiscrimination.umunze_consent_fee: the premium alone (engine plant), the processing fee alone, seven per cent of the bonus, seven per cent of the bonus and the reimbursement
fieldsDiscrimination.akpugo_ezi_evii: the likelihoods swapped, no dry-hole cost, the bonus twice (engine plants), the EVPI as the EVII
fieldsDiscrimination.akpugo_strong_posterior_pct: the likelihoods swapped (engine plant), the likelihood as the posterior, the prior unchanged, the signal chance
fieldsDiscrimination.akpugo_risked_value_per_pct: the value per percent unrisked and no dry-hole cost (engine plants), the success value before the well, the risked success value alone
fieldsDiscrimination.akpugo_price_to_value: priced on the unrisked value and no dry-hole cost (engine plants), the price over the 100% value, the interest left out
fieldsDiscrimination.akpugo_2035_carry_balance: no uplift, recovered from the whole share, carried in full (wrong terms through the engine)
fieldsDiscrimination.akpugo_backin_refund_to_obr: exploration refunded (a wrong term through the engine), the refund on the target interest, in equal parts, on the licence interest
